rules: evidence_grade is copied from the catalogue entry (projects.json) at build time; the catalogue record is authoritative and a video never changes a grade.
upload_status original = posted by the project author, lab or institution; repost and commentary videos link to original_of or covers.
playback link-only: no video plays inside Digital Fly Lab pages; open url on the original platform. Nothing is re-hosted.
views are snapshots on views_date, not a quality signal.
